profile.headline: Telecommunication Engineering Student
about: Telecommunication Engineering student at PENS who loves exploring cybersecurity, frontend development, and AI-assisted workflows.
I focus on building practical systems—from interactive web applications and CTF security write-ups to IoT-based smart solutions.

research.narrative: I build and secure modern software systems, combining frontend engineering, IoT microcontrollers, and continuous problem-solving through Capture The Flag (CTF) challenges.
